name: weighted_indicator_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-4
thesis: Static indicator weights (equal weighting in a consensus system) are suboptimal because different indicators perform better in different regimes. By tracking each indicator's recent predictive accuracy over the last 50 signals and dynamically adjusting weights via exponential performance weighting, the composite signal naturally emphasizes whichever indicator is currently 'hot'. This is a form of online learning applied to indicator combination. The inefficiency exists because dynamically weighting indicators requires tracking signal-level P&L attribution, which is computationally expensive and beyond most retail platforms. The edge is in the meta-level learning: the strategy improves its own indicator selection in real-time.
stock_filter: ADV(20) > ₹100 Cr; stock must have generated at least 50 signals from each indicator in last 20 sessions for weight calibration

indicators.name: Ind2_RSI
indicators.params: 1 if RSI(close,14) < 35 else (-1 if RSI(close,14) > 65 else 0)

indicators.name: Weight_i
indicators.params: exp(alpha * hit_rate_i_last_50) / sum(exp(alpha * hit_rate_j_last_50)) where alpha=2.0

conditions: At least 3 of 5 indicators are +1 (minimum breadth requirement)

exit.trailing_stop: After 22 bps profit, trail at 12 bps from high-water mark
exit.signal_exit: Weighted_Score crosses zero against position direction

risk.position_sizing: Scale with Weighted_Score: ₹75K if score 0.60-0.70, ₹1L if 0.70-0.85, ₹1.25L if > 0.85

filters.trend_filter: NIFTY 50 not in extreme move (abs(ROC(NIFTY, 30)) < 80 bps)
other_filters: All indicator weights must be > 0.05 (no indicator completely zeroed out — prevents overfitting to recent regime)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low-Medium — the meta-learning component adapts to indicator performance shifts; edge decays only if all 5 base indicators simultaneously lose predictive power

weaknesses: Performance-weighted indicators can overfit to recent regime — if RSI had a hot streak, it gets high weight just as the regime may be changing, causing the strategy to lag regime transitions

The alpha=2.0 temperature parameter in the softmax weighting is arbitrary and sensitive — too high concentrates weight on one indicator, too low approaches equal weighting, negating the strategy's purpose
Tracking 50 signal-level P&L attributions per indicator per stock requires substantial bookkeeping infrastructure; errors in P&L attribution corrupt the weights
prior_art: Exponential weighting in online learning (Hedge algorithm, Freund & Schapire 1997); dynamic model combination in Bayesian model averaging; applied to technical indicators is a practical extension
notes: Consider using a Thompson Sampling approach instead of softmax weighting — it naturally balances exploration (trying underperforming indicators) and exploitation (relying on proven ones). The minimum weight floor of 0.05 partially addresses this but is ad-hoc.
